content: आच्छिद् €7 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To cut off or away, tear, cut in pieces, break; आच्छिद्य धमनीमपि <ls>Mb.</ls>; धनुः, ज्याम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To snatch away, tear from, take away; जातवेदोमुखान्मायी मिषतामाच्छिनत्ति नः <ls>Ku. 2. 46</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 28</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">8. 9</ls>; <ls>Dk. 99</ls>. .²3 To disregard, take no notice of (as words); मम वच आच्छिद्य in spite of, notwithstanding, my words. .²4 To cut off, exclude; भर्तारमाच्छेत्स्यसि कामिनीभ्यः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²5 To remove. .²6 To take out, extract, draw or pull off.
